title: Getting Started with SIMPLE: Platform Trial Simulation
text: Platform trials innovative, adaptive clinical trials allow multiple investigational treatments evaluated simultaneously common control arm within single trial infrastructure. Unlike traditional two-arm trials, platform trials: Add treatments time: New investigational arms (ISAs - Intervention-Specific Appendices) can enter platform started Drop ineffective treatments: Arms showing futility can stopped early platform continues Share control data: common control arm can shared across multiple treatment comparisons, improving efficiency Conduct interim analyses: Regular decision points allow adaptive modifications Continue indefinitely: platform remains open long research questions answer design particularly valuable areas multiple therapies need evaluation (e.g., oncology, infectious diseases, rare diseases) can significantly reduce time cost drug development.

title: ISA Inclusion Rules: The lNewIntr Module
text: Add 1 ISA every 6 months (26 weeks)  Use case: Planned pipeline treatments arrive predictable schedule
code: fixed_entry <- new_lNewIntr(   fnNewIntr = function(lPltfTrial, lAddArgs) {     # Check if it's been 26 weeks since last ISA was added     time_since_last <- lPltfTrial$lSnap$dCurrTime - max(lPltfTrial$lSnap$vIntrInclTimes)          if (time_since_last >= lAddArgs$nTimeDiff) {       return(1)  # Add 1 ISA     } else {       return(0)  # Wait     }   },   lAddArgs = list(nTimeDiff = 26)  # 26 weeks = ~6 months )  plot(fixed_entry, dCurrTime = 1:104)  # Show 2 years

title: ISA Inclusion Rules: The lNewIntr Module
text: Never exceed 5 concurrent ISAs, add slots available  Use case: Limited enrollment capacity operational constraints
code: capacity_limited <- new_lNewIntr(   fnNewIntr = function(lPltfTrial, lAddArgs) {     current_active <- lPltfTrial$lSnap$dActvIntr     max_capacity <- lAddArgs$nIntrMax          if (current_active < max_capacity) {       # Slot available - add 1 ISA with 40% probability each week       return(rbinom(1, 1, lAddArgs$prob_inclusion))     } else {       return(0)  # At capacity, wait     }   },   lAddArgs = list(     nIntrMax = 5,     prob_inclusion = 0.4   ) )  plot(capacity_limited)

title: ISA Inclusion Rules: The lNewIntr Module
text: Add multiple ISAs pipeline releases  Use case: Multiple treatments complete preclinical studies simultaneously
code: burst_entry <- new_lNewIntr(   fnNewIntr = function(lPltfTrial, lAddArgs) {     current_active <- lPltfTrial$lSnap$dActvIntr     max_capacity <- lAddArgs$nIntrMax     available_slots <- max_capacity - current_active          if (available_slots > 0) {       # Randomly add 0, 1, or 2 ISAs (but not more than available slots)       to_add <- sample(0:2, 1, prob = c(0.5, 0.3, 0.2))  # 50% none, 30% one, 20% two       return(min(to_add, available_slots))     }     return(0)   },   lAddArgs = list(nIntrMax = 5) )  plot(burst_entry)

title: ISA Inclusion Rules: The lNewIntr Module
text: Imagine designing platform novel cancer immunotherapies: Requirements: Start 2 ISAs (treatments already approved Phase 2) Maximum 6 concurrent ISAs (enrollment capacity) Add new ISA least 12 weeks (time assess safety) Stop adding 8 total ISAs evaluated ISAs run variable duration (15-25 weeks decision)
code: oncology_platform <- new_lNewIntr(   fnNewIntr = function(lPltfTrial, lAddArgs) {     current_time <- lPltfTrial$lSnap$dCurrTime     current_active <- lPltfTrial$lSnap$dActvIntr     total_so_far <- length(lPltfTrial$lSnap$vIntrInclTimes)     last_entry <- max(lPltfTrial$lSnap$vIntrInclTimes)          # Check all conditions     weeks_since_last <- current_time - last_entry     slot_available <- current_active < lAddArgs$max_concurrent     not_at_total_limit <- total_so_far < lAddArgs$max_total     waited_long_enough <- weeks_since_last >= lAddArgs$min_wait          # Add 1 ISA if all conditions met     if (slot_available && not_at_total_limit && waited_long_enough) {       return(1)     }     return(0)   },   lAddArgs = list(     max_concurrent = 6,     max_total = 8,     min_wait = 12   ) )  # Visualize with variable ISA durations plot(   oncology_platform,   nIntrStart = 2,   dCurrTime = 1:100,   cIntrTime = "random",   dIntrTimeParam = 0.05  # ~5% chance of completing each week (avg 20 weeks) )
